claim_text: Have all of our businesses identify at least one critical health hazard material to their business and demonstrate a year-on-year reduction of exposure to that hazard.
metric_name: Assets achieving an exposure reduction to known health risks
context_text: Have all of our businesses identify at least one critical health hazard material to their business and demonstrate a year-on-year reduction of exposure to that hazard.；14 of our assets across Rio Tinto achieved an exposure reduction to known health risks (airborne contaminants and noise). (2024: 6 assets).；We implemented 22 targeted projects across 14 assets to successfully reduce exposures to known health risks for our employees and contractors.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: FY25有14个资产实现了已知健康风险暴露下降，且相关减暴项目在正文中被进一步说明，支持充分。
notes: 证据合并自绩效目标页与职业健康章节。
llm_reason: The claim asserts a universal achievement that 'all of our businesses' have identified hazards and demonstrated year-on-year exposure reduction. The evidence states that '14 of our assets... achieved an exposure reduction' without providing the total number of assets or businesses to verify that 14 represents 'all'. The phrasing '14 of our assets' implies a subset rather than totality, meaning the decisive assertion regarding universal scope is unverified and materially overstated relative to the evidence provided.
